CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Physical has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   A. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

   C. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

10. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

12. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)

   B. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.

   D. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

14. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)

15. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
